trackDescription: Focuses on Slalom’s business by delivering capabilities and offerings to customers, and supports business growth through excellent delivery. Leaders in this track are accountable for ensuring the successful delivery of team projects and cultivating talent within their teams.
jobTitleSummary: Fosters a high-performance culture, facilitates team strategy aligned to business outcomes and manages the delivery of multiple projects through strategic thinking, influencing and coaching teams. Supports operational and financial health while developing extensive client networks.

Deliver Exceptionally.expectation: Manages the impact of scope and prioritization changes on client relationships.
Oversees risk management, ensuring teams proactively identify risks and follow structured escalation paths.
Leverages expertise, Slalom and industry best practices, and emerging technologies to guide teams in developing high-quality solutions, generating best practices.
Balances strategic and analytical thinking, adopts new methodologies, and encourages experimentation and innovation.
Ensures teams are chasing the right outcomes, redirecting as needed, so solutions drive measurable and sustainable impact.

Develops precise and audience-tailored written communications, adjusting tone and detail for cross-functional teams and leadership, to drive alignment on strategic initiatives and clearly articulate the value delivered to clients.
Demonstrates the ability to read an audience and influence cross-functional teams to build trust, create accountability, and drive clear decisions in complex business discussions.
Well-networked across the client organization to serve delivery needs; known for depth of expertise.
Understands client business priorities and challenges, making connections, infusing industry / partner expertise, and acting as a challenger (as appropriate).
Enables engagement and capability teams in implementing Customer Love strategies.
Encourages and role models the use of emerging technologies (e.g., AI, AI agents) and related best practices to enhance productivity and delivery outcomes.
Responsible for delivery and management of low- and high-touch projects within or across capabilities, geographies, outcomes and/or industries.
Optimizes project structures, roles, planning and estimation, and ways of working, driving Delivery Excellence.
Coaches and optimizes delivery efficiency, velocity and predictability.
Leads discussions on how engagement outcomes tie into the client’s overarching business strategy and potential long-term gains.
Helps grow client relationships through consistent demonstration of impact and alignment with their strategic goals.
Mentors and coaches team members of all levels on articulating value, from discussions of ROI to storytelling techniques.

Grow Expertise.expectation: Deepens and/or broadens mastery in Functional / Technical roles (e.g., Advanced+ 2+; Expert in 1+).
Develops in Engagement roles (e.g., Delivery Solution Lead, Engagement Lead, Accountable Executive).
Develops in Pursuit Roles (e.g., Sales Solution Lead, Accountable Executive).
Develops and upskills as a People Leader.
Coaches others on Functional / Technical roles and delivery methodologies (e.g., Delivery Excellence).
Collaborates with others to identify, develop, and implement learning initiatives that close capability talent gaps and build emerging skills.
Manages knowledge management practices, ensuring delivery and capability teams are contributing to and leveraging Slalom's knowledge capital.
Collaborates with capability and market solutions leaders to shape and enhance solutions, providing real-world perspectives on effectiveness, scalability, and client impact.
Actively develops their team's understanding of capability, solution, and/or industry trends and best practices in a way that supports their work
Leads with curiosity, proactively deepening current state knowledge and trends related to capability, industry, and/or solutions.
Sought out for delivery expertise internally, mentoring colleagues by sharing insights and providing opportunities for shadowing.

Grow Slalom.expectation: Shapes Slalom culture by modeling core values on engagements and within teams, creating meaningful connections in both physical and digital environments.
Intentionally grows and leverages professional network in delivery environments and areas of interest and expertise to increase collaboration and delivery impact.
Mentors team members on best practices for maintaining brand integrity in project execution, enhancing client satisfaction and loyalty.
Well-networked across relevant Slalom delivery / capability areas and recognized for expertise; helps others navigate communities.
Encourages others to engage in Slalom events and internal initiatives (e.g., employee resource groups,  learning events).
Educates others about Slalom's business and strategy, especially in context of capability.
Shares expertise and delivery learnings with capability and market solutions leaders to inform discipline, sub-capability, and capability planning.
Educates others about key delivery metrics / drivers (e.g., revenue, Customer Love, continuous quality).
Manages talent management processes in discipline, sub-capability, and capability (e.g., talent acquisition, onboarding, staffing, performance management, engagement, retention).
Proactively identifies and relays opportunities for Slalom through client relationships while factoring in customer strengths and ROI considerations.
Proactively identifies market needs and recommends adjustments to solutions and strategy to meet demand accordingly.
Manages operational and financial health of capability (e.g., staffing, utilization, billable hours, team size, bill rates), with a focus on direct reporting team.
When managing an engagement, effectively oversees project financials and mentors team members on engagement financial management best practices.
Supports new and emerging leader growth in alignment with future leader needs and decisions outlined by capability leaders.
Contributes to sales solutioning and/or oversee pursuits, especially in the context of delivery environments.
Partners with Industry, Account, Market Solutions leaders to help proactively shape deals and ensure a smooth transition from sales to delivery.

Lead.expectation: Models self-management, resilience, and accountability for others.
Models prioritization and empowers teams with strategies for managing ambiguity and balancing workload.
Reflects to promote a deeper understanding of self and awareness of own agency.
Proactively addresses growth opportunities and engages in career development planning.
Models curiosity for multiple perspectives to mitigate bias and improve relationships.
Maintains appropriate balance of self-confidence and humility.
Fosters a culture where constructive tension leads to best results.
Holds self and teams accountable for giving and requesting clear and constructive feedback (e.g., on-demand, performance reviews, end-of-engagement).
Normalizes providing upward feedback (e.g., to managers or senior leaders).
Leads with empathy by anticipating fears and concerns, approaching team members with compassion.
Manages and navigates change across groups, ensuring alignment, mitigating resistance, and fostering adoption through clear communication.
Sets internal team strategy and collaborates with peers to enable organizational success.
Facilitates alignment between team actions and business outcomes.
Proactively shares team updates to broader audiences in order to build awareness and support connection to Slalom priorities.
Understands team member career aspirations and interests, growth trajectory, engagement, and organizational impact.
Actively supports team member career development planning and helps tailor development opportunities for individual and business impact.
Ensures directs understand performance expectations and helps leaders within people tree set and uphold performance expectations.
Proactively identifies early signs of performance gaps, ensuring leaders within people tree take action on concerns, and drives accountability.
Assess directs' performance against defined expectations and outcomes.
Leads or co-leads calibration discussions, ensuring alignment with organizational performance standards, and drives consistency in team performance evaluation and differentiation.

quantitativeExpectations: Personal Contribution Credit (PCC): • Low: $500K • Target: $1.5M • High: $2.5M+
Business Outcome Targets: Individuals will work with their leaders to determine the business outcome that makes sense for their individual situation based on market maturity & complexity.
